deleted_starters.text: Never fire a shot you can't afford.
Only fire at a robot you saw this turn, with the gun aimed at it.
Never drive toward a wall or building closer than 80 px.

explanation.headline: No Verus verdicts were reported; the battles show rules S2 and S3 broken
explanation.summary: No rules or Verus verdicts were included in the evidence, so I can't say which rules Verus proved or rejected. In the battles, S2 was broken from turn 0 (7 turns in the open arena, 13 in the city) and S3 from turn 2 (42 turns in the open, 148 in the city). I don't have the text of S2 or S3, so I can't say what they require.
